description: Get the z-score, percentile and annualized volatility of a commodity's latest price against its trailing window of daily prices, each with a plain-language interpretation. Use when the user asks whether a price is unusually high or low, or how volatile it has been. opa_get_history returns the underlying series. Analytics are plan-gated: the API answers HTTP 403 when the account's plan does not include them. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.
name: opa_get_price_statistics
title: Get Price Statistics
